_comment: Chapter 1 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F02, a comic side quest: Sir Wobbles, the slime knight (he comes back in later chapters).

text.zh_TW: 一隻頭上頂著水桶的史萊姆擋住了路。「站住！吾乃塔之騎士——晃晃爵士！」
text.en: A slime wearing a bucket blocks the way. "Halt! I am a knight of the tower: Sir Wobbles!"

text.zh_TW: 「這是頭盔！！」它氣得整個身體都在晃。「騎士才不會被無禮的平民傷到……嗚嗚……」
text.en: "It is a HELMET!!" It wobbles with rage. "A knight is never hurt by rude commoners... sniff..."

text.zh_TW: 晃晃爵士：「哼哼，有禮貌的平民！吾賜你騎士團的祝福！」它吐出一瓶黏黏的藥水。「下次見面，吾會更強！」
text.en: Sir Wobbles: "Hmph, a polite commoner! Accept the blessing of my order!" It spits out a sticky potion. "When we meet again, I shall be mightier!"
